title: TCP/IP Model
html:
The practical, simplified model the real internet is actually built on.

Also called the Internet Protocol Suite. While OSI is a 7-layer conceptual reference model used for teaching and design, TCP/IP is the simpler 5-layer practical model that real-world networking protocols actually map onto.

OSI (7 layers)TCP/IP (5 layers)
Application, Presentation, SessionApplication
TransportTransport
NetworkNetwork (Internet)
Data LinkData Link
PhysicalPhysical
Key distinction

OSI is concept-based — it exists to help engineers reason about and design networking systems in clean, separated responsibilities. TCP/IP is implementation-based — it's the actual model the internet runs on, where the top three OSI layers are collapsed into one practical Application layer.
